title: Engineering Tech Lead - Python and Java
description:
About the job 
 TO BE ELIGIBLE FOR THIS ROLE YOU MUST HAVE PRIOR EXPERIENCE IN MANAGING HIGH VOLUME EVENTS DRIVEN ARCHITECTURE OF A FINTECH/MARKETPLACE PLATFORM 
 The role We are seeking an experienced Engineering Tech Lead - Python or Java to join our core team and take ownership of the technology behind our B2C platform, used by 100,000s of customers monthly. Your primary focus will be to build a scalable, robust, and secure backend system that powers our platform. You will oversee architecture design, work with a distributed engineering team, and directly contribute critical parts of the codebase. 
 As a tech lead, you will translate our business strategies into product and technical requirements, in close collaboration with other Engineers, Product Manager and the wider business team, including the stakeholders. 
 What youll do Backend Architecture & Development: Architect and implement backend systems and APIs using Java, Python and modern frameworks. Write maintainable, scalable, and testable code. Infrastructure & DevOps: Design and maintain a secure, highly available AWS infrastructure. Implement CI/CD pipelines, manage containerization (Docker), orchestration (Kubernetes or Docker Swarm), and configuration management (Ansible). Systems & Security: Ensure system reliability by monitoring, upgrading, and optimizing Linux/Ubuntu hosts. Implement robust security measures, managing IAM roles, permissions etc. Data Infrastructure: Work extensively with MongoDB and Mongoose to design efficient schemas and ensure seamless data flow. Integration & Third-Party Services: Integrate external APIs and services into our backend ecosystem. Collaborate with the front-end team to ensure smooth data consumption. Technical Leadership: Distribute tasks, conduct code reviews, drive process improvements, and help shape our distributed engineering team by participating in hiring decisions. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with colleagues and external stakeholders to translate business goals into technical solutions that are both scalable and efficient. 
 Who you are Technical skills: 8+ years of backend engineering experience within high volume data-intensive technology companies. Preferably in fintech , ideally relating to credit . Strong expertise in Data Structures, Algorithms, and scalable system design. Excellent proficiency in Python or Java, REST APIs, and Microservices architecture. Strong hands-on experience building scalable, resilient, and high-performance distributed systems. Experience with AWS cloud services and cloud-native application development. Good understanding of databases, caching, asynchronous processing, messaging systems, and performance optimization. Strong understanding of engineering best practices, SDLC, code reviews, CI/CD, observability, and production debugging. Ability to drive technical design discussions and independently own critical backend services. Strong collaboration and communication skills in cross-functional environments. 
 Preferred Experience in Fintech, Lending, Payments, or other high-throughput transactional systems. Exposure to Kubernetes, Docker, and event-driven architectures is an added advantage. 
 Soft skills: Collaborative skills. Youre excited to work in collaboration with other engineers within a multicultural, distributed environment, and have exceptional communication skills. Business mindset. You care to know how the code you write serves customers. Scrappy. You like moving fast, rolling up your sleeves and getting Sh*t done. 
 Benefits Competitive salary + generous equity package. Monthly company team events. Possibility of Visa sponsorship to migrate to London.

Key Skills: Backend Development,Infrastructure development,Python,Software engineering,Java,Engineering,Infrastructure,Technical analysis

title: SME - Phd in STEM
description:
We are looking for highly qualified PhD holders with python, faculty members and experienced Subject Matter Experts for specialized, project-based assignments involving scientific research, STEM problem-solving, scientific reasoning, AI response evaluation, technical content development and subject-matter validation . 
 Key Responsibilities Conduct advanced research and scientific analysis. Create and validate complex STEM problems and solutions. Develop research workflows, evaluation criteria and technical content. Evaluate AI-generated responses for scientific accuracy and reasoning. Perform literature reviews and evidence-based analysis. Provide specialized subject-matter validation and technical expertise. Required Qualifications Completed PhD in a relevant STEM discipline, such as Physics, Chemistry, Biotechnology, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field. Working knowledge of at least one programming language, preferably Python, R, MATLAB, or C++. Demonstrable experience applying programming in doctoral research or professional projects. Experience in computational analysis, simulations, data processing, numerical methods, or algorithm development. Ability to independently develop or modify code rather than relying exclusively on prebuilt software. 
 Technical Skills Essential Skills Programming: Python, R, MATLAB, C++, C, Java, or Julia. Research coding: Custom scripts, computational research projects, and algorithm implementation. Data analysis: Data processing, statistical analysis, and research dataset analysis. Scientific computing: Computational modelling, numerical methods, or simulations. 
 Additional / Preferred Skills Data analysis libraries: Pandas, NumPy, and SciPy. Machine learning and AI: Scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, deep learning, or NLP, depending on project requirements. Software development: Git/GitHub, debugging, testing, algorithms, and data structures. Databases: SQL, PostgreSQL, or MySQL. Automation: Research workflow automation and data pipelines. High-performance computing: Linux, HPC, parallel computing, CUDA, or cloud computing, where relevant. 
 Candidate Experience Levels Level 1 Basic Coding: Uses programming for research calculations, plotting, basic statistical analysis, and simple scripts. Level 2 Intermediate / Research Coding: Develops research scripts, implements algorithms, performs advanced data analysis, builds simulations, and automates workflows. Level 3 – Advanced Coding: Develops complex software, optimizes algorithms, writes tested code, works with large datasets, and applies software engineering practices. 
 CV Screening Criteria Candidates will be evaluated based on: Completion of a PhD in a relevant STEM discipline. Proficiency in at least one programming language. Practical coding experience in research or professional projects. Experience with computational analysis, simulations, data processing, or algorithm development. Evidence of independently developing or modifying code, supported by specific projects, research work, or professional achievements. 
 Important: Merely listing Python, MATLAB, or another programming language in the CV is not sufficient. Candidates should demonstrate how they used programming to solve research problems or achieve measurable outcomes. Suitable Candidate Profiles STEM PhD researchers with hands-on programming experience. Computational scientists and scientific programmers. Researchers experienced in numerical modelling and simulations. STEM researchers with strong data analysis and automation skills. Advanced coding candidates with software development or AI/ML experience, where relevant to the project. 
 Mandatory Resume Details Full Name | Highest Qualification | Specialization/Research Area | Current Designation | Relevant Experience | Research Experience | Publication Details | Google Scholar URL | H-index | LinkedIn URL | Contact Number | Email ID

Job Description: 
 Primary (70%): Web scraping architecture anti-bot, distributed crawling, proxy/CAPTCHA 
 strategy, compliance 
 •
 •
 Secondary (30%): Data engineering pipelines, lakehouse, orchestration, dbt 
 Mandatory ownership of the technical solution and effort estimation for every new 
 scraping proposal/RFP 
 •
 •
 Senior profile: 9+ years overall, 5+ years in scraping, 4+ years in data engineering 
 Technical Lead / Architect Web Scraping & Data Engineering 
 Role Title Solution Architect Web Scraping (Primary) & Data Engineering (Secondary) 
 Location: Remote 
 Primary Focus Web Scraping & Data Extraction Architecture (~70%) 
 Secondary Focus Data Engineering & Pipeline Architecture (~30%) 
 1. Role Summary: 
 We are seeking a Technical lead the design and delivery of large-scale web scraping and 
 data extraction solutions, with strong supporting expertise in data engineering, the 
 technical authority on all scraping initiatives from pre-sales solutioning and effort 
 estimation through to architecture, build, and stabilization. 
 The primary mandate is web scraping: designing resilient crawlers, anti-bot strategies, 
 distributed extraction systems, and compliance frameworks. The secondary mandate is 
 data engineering: ensuring extracted data flows reliably into well-modelled, query-ready 
 storage layers and downstream analytical or operational systems. 
 Mandatory Involvement Areas: 
 •
 •
 •
 Author or co-author the technical solution section of every new RFP / RFI / proposal 
 document for scraping projects. 
 Lead technical discovery calls with prospective clients to understand target sources, data 
 SLAs, volume, and compliance constraints. 
 Conduct target-site feasibility assessments anti-bot complexity, dynamic content, 
 login walls, geo-restrictions, rate limits and document findings before commercials 
 are committed. 
 •
 •
 Own end-to-end effort estimation for scraping engagements: crawler build effort, 
 infrastructure sizing, proxy and CAPTCHA cost projections, maintenance overhead, and 
 contingency. 
 Produce solution architecture diagrams, tech stack recommendations, and assumption 
 logs as part of every proposal. 
 •
 •
 Define and document SLAs, KPIs, and acceptance criteria proposed to the client. 
 Participate in client orals, technical defence sessions, and commercial negotiations as 
 the technical SPOC. 
 •
 Maintain an internal estimation knowledge base reusable estimation templates, 
 complexity matrices, target-site classification, and historical actuals and continuously 
 refine it after every project closure. 
 
 
 
 •
 Sign off on the technical feasibility and risk profile of every proposal before submission. 
 No scraping proposal goes out without architect approval. 
 3. Core Responsibilities 
 3.1 Scraping Architecture & Design (Primary) 
 •
 •
 •
 •
 •
 Design end-to-end scraping solutions covering crawl orchestration, extraction, parsing, 
 storage, and downstream data consumption. 
 Define reference architectures for high-volume, high-velocity, and high-variety scraping 
 use cases. 
 Architect resilient systems handling JavaScript-heavy sites, CAPTCHAs, rate limiting, IP 
 blocking, and frequent DOM changes. 
 Evaluate and select frameworks, proxy networks, and anti-bot bypass strategies aligned 
 with cost, performance, and compliance. 
 Design data quality, deduplication, validation, and schema-evolution strategies for 
 scraped data. 
 3.2 Data Engineering Architecture (Secondary) 
 •
 •
 •
 •
 •
 Design downstream data pipelines that ingest, transform, and serve scraped data to 
 analytics, ML, or operational consumers. 
 Architect lakehouse / warehouse layers, define data modelling standards (dimensional, 
 Data Vault, or hybrid), and govern schema evolution. 
 Define ELT/ETL patterns, orchestration strategy, and SLA-backed data freshness 
 commitments. 
 Establish data quality, observability, lineage, and cataloguing practices across the 
 platform. 
 Recommend storage formats, partitioning, and indexing strategies for cost and query 
 performance. 
 3.3 Delivery Leadership 
 •
 Translate business requirements into technical specifications, sprint plans, and 
 implementation roadmaps. 
 •
 •
 Produce HLD, LLD, and Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) for each engagement. 
 Provide hands-on guidance, perform code reviews, and mentor scraping and data 
 engineers. 
 •
 Drive proof-of-concept (PoC) builds for complex or high-risk targets before full-scale 
 rollout. 
 3.4 Compliance, Risk & Governance 
 •
 •
 •
 Ensure all scraping work adheres to applicable laws and platform terms (GDPR, CCPA, 
 DPDP, robots.txt, copyright). 
 Define and enforce ethical scraping practices, request throttling, and PII handling 
 guidelines. 
 Conduct risk assessments for each target source and recommend mitigations. 
 
 
 
 3.5 Performance, Cost & Operations 
 •
 •
 •
 Establish SLAs for crawl freshness, completeness, and accuracy. 
 Design monitoring, alerting, and self-healing mechanisms for scraping pipelines. 
 Optimise infrastructure cost (compute, proxies, storage) without compromising delivery 
 KPIs. 
 4. Required Technical Skills Primary (Web Scraping) 
 These are non-negotiable. The candidate must demonstrate deep, hands-on expertise in 
 each of the following: 
 4.1 Scraping Frameworks & Tooling 
 •
 •
 •
 Expert-level Python: Scrapy, BeautifulSoup, lxml, Requests, httpx, parsel. 
 Headless browser automation: Playwright, Puppeteer, Selenium, Pyppeteer. 
 Node.js scraping stack (where applicable): Puppeteer, Cheerio, Crawlee. 
 4.2 Anti-Bot & Evasion Strategy 
 •
 •
 •
 •
 Proven experience bypassing Cloudflare, Akamai Bot Manager, DataDome, PerimeterX, 
 Imperva, Kasada. 
 CAPTCHA handling: reCAPTCHA v2/v3, hCaptcha, FunCaptcha, image / audio solvers; 
 integration with 2Captcha, Anti-Captcha, CapSolver. 
 TLS / JA3 / JA4 fingerprinting awareness; HTTP/2 fingerprint evasion; browser fingerprint 
 spoofing. 
 Stealth plugins, user-agent rotation, header normalisation, cookie / session 
 management at scale. 
 4.3 Proxy & Network Infrastructure 
 •
 •
 •
 Hands-on experience with rotating, residential, mobile, ISP, and datacenter proxies. 
 Integration with providers: Bright Data, Oxylabs, Smartproxy, NetNut, IPRoyal, SOAX. 
 Proxy pool design, health-checking, geo-targeting, sticky sessions, and cost optimisation. 
 4.4 Parsing & Extraction 
 •
 •
 •
 XPath, CSS selectors, regex, JSON-LD, microdata, RDFa. 
 Reverse-engineering of internal / mobile APIs, GraphQL endpoints, and XHR traffic. 
 ML/LLM-assisted extraction for unstructured layouts (nice-to-have, increasingly 
 expected). 
 4.5 Distributed Crawling & Orchestration 
 •
 Scrapy-Redis, Scrapy Cluster, Frontera, Crawlee, or equivalent distributed crawling 
 frameworks. 
 •
 •
 Job scheduling and orchestration with Apache Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, or Celery. 
 Queue-based architectures using Kafka, RabbitMQ, AWS SQS, GCP Pub/Sub. 
 5. Required Technical Skills Secondary (Data Engineering) 
 
 
 
 Working-to-strong proficiency expected. The architect must be able to design, review, and 
 guide data engineering work without depending on a separate data architect. 
 5.1 Data Pipelines & Orchestration 
 •
 ETL / ELT design patterns, idempotent pipelines, CDC (Change Data Capture), 
 incremental loads. 
 •
 •
 •
 Apache Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, AWS Glue, Azure Data Factory, GCP Dataflow.

title: Principal Software Development Engineer
description:
Job Overview This is an expert-level position responsible for working with Product Development architects, management, and product managers to ensure products are meeting technical and business requirements; providing high-level research and analysis related to software design and development; solving complex problems; and establishing technical standards and best practices. This role sits at the heart of ELB Learning's flagship Lectora Online product as it enters an exciting period of modernization, including the delivery of new AI-powered authoring features. The successful candidate will be a senior member of a small, high-trust engineering team and will own significant architectural decisions across the product. Key Responsibilities Design and code units/modules that meet functional, non-functional, quality requirements on schedule; satisfying definition of done. Put forward accurate time estimates of work to be done on a project. Complete all scheduled tasks on time. Perform unit/module testing of software to find errors and confirm programs meet specifications. Fix bugs, add enhancements, and convert software to other platforms. Evaluate impact of software performance, and recommend improvements. Write and maintain documentation to describe program development, logic, coding, testing, changes, and corrections. Provide product content to technical writers and review for technical accuracy. Lead improvement of Product Development practices and procedures. Participate in design and code reviews with other developers. Assist quality assurance team and support personnel as needed to determine system problems. Mentor, train, develop, and serve as a knowledge resource for less experienced Software Engineers. Perform strategic research and design for a major technical area. Design patentable technology and propose and review patent applications. Serve as subject matter expert on product or components. Own a major component of the product. Work with marketing and product management to ensure ELB Learning's technology is positioned effectively. Participate in grooming of product backlog with product management, development, architecture, and other stakeholders. Communicate project status to all interested parties and ensure the team stays on track to satisfy business needs and client expectations. Ensure completeness and quality of all project deliverables. Identify and escalate issues and, when necessary, pull appropriate teams together to solve challenges/issues. Recognize potential risks and implement a course of action to address them appropriately. Provide leadership and direction for test automation, test planning, triage, isolation, and troubleshooting. Drive test plan reviews and continuous improvement efforts. Effectively communicate testing activities and findings in oral and written format. Develop and utilize automated test scripts to perform duties. Develop and execute customer-focused test cases and maintain associated records. Integrate test suites into the test management system and test harness. Visualize, articulate, and break down complex testing areas into simpler parts. Initiate and influence test strategies across specific product areas. Preferred Education Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field required, Master's degree preferred. Additional leadership training is beneficial. Work Experience 6+ years of experience in software development. Possess extensive experience with complex products and expert-level knowledge across multiple product areas. Experience in a technical lead role with demonstrated ability to mentor other Software Development Engineers. Skills & Competencies Expert-level design/debugging/coding skills. Quality-driven thought process. Complex problem-solving skills. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Strong analytical skills. Strong technical skills. Familiarity with learning technologies preferred. Technical leadership. Self-motivated. Proactively solve problems for the benefit of the team. Strong teamwork skills for cross-group cooperation. Skilled in time management. Accurate time estimates. Ability to perform under pressure. Business domain expertise. Ability to prioritize workload. Coaching and mentoring skills. Requirements analysis. Defect root cause identification and analysis. Specific Skills & Technologies for this Position Primary Skills (required): Java 8 (deep expertise required): server-side application development. J2EE technologies (Web Applications, Servlets, Filters). Experience with JavaScript/TypeScript and modern web front-end frameworks. MySQL: schema design, query optimization, and performance tuning. Apache Tomcat: application server configuration, deployment, and tuning. Strong understanding of web application architecture, REST APIs, and multi-tenant SaaS patterns. Secondary Skills (strongly preferred): Experience migrating from monolithic architectures to modern frameworks (Vue 3, Tailwind CSS). Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and CI/CD pipelines. Nice-to-Have Skills: Exposure to AI / LLM-powered product features. Experience with the eLearning or content authoring domain.
